description: Blargg GB halt_bug.gb and interrupt_time.gb from the retrio/gb-test-roms mirror, with the cartridge header's RAM-size byte ($0149) set to $02 (8 KiB) by rgbfix. Both ROMs already run blargg's newer shell and write the $A000 result block (status, $DE $B0 $61 signature, text); upstream's header declares MBC1+RAM ($0147 = $02) but RAM size 0, so an emulator that honours the header maps no cart RAM and the block is invisible. No code byte changes: rgbfix rewrites $0149 and the header checksum ($014D); the global checksum stays valid without change.
license: No licence file upstream (blargg's readmes carry no restriction). Treated as patch-only: this recipe and PROVENANCE.md are committed, the built ROMs never are.
golden_gate_reason: Nothing is assembled: halt_bug has no source anywhere upstream, and the input to this recipe is upstream's own shipped binary at the pinned SHA (sha256 ddebfb81... / 1a8f8f3b..., identical to the c-sp v7.0 bundle copies). The only change is the header fix-up, verified byte-for-byte in PROVENANCE.md (exactly $0149 and $014D differ).
